title: OWASP SAMM v2.2.0 core model — document types (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED by this library from the 302 YAML files of github.com/owaspsamm/core v2.2.0 model/. SAMM publishes no schema of its own; this is a machine-checkable rendering of the structure the files actually have. x-references names the document type a GUID field points at (resolved by id). Validate a single file against #/$defs/<type> chosen by its `type` field. Validation of all 302 files holds only under a YAML 1.2 loader: under YAML 1.1 (PyYAML) the 24 answer-set files fail because the unquoted option text `No` becomes boolean false (see AnswerSet values[].text).

SOURCE DEFECT (found in verification 2026-10-03): all 24 answer sets write the first option unquoted as `text: No`, which a YAML 1.1 loader (e.g. PyYAML safe_load) reads as boolean false, not the string "No". Load with a YAML 1.2 / string-preserving loader (or quote it) before validating; with PyYAML all 24 answer-set files fail this property.
